players.product: isostatic graphite, carbon insulation and coated graphite parts for SiC crystal growth and epitaxy

quarterly_data.signal: Other businesses (management): EV sales around EUR 15 million in H1 (CFO), with fuse selections by Ford and Leapmotor and a CATL nomination at the end of 2025; busbar deliveries to ACC were close to three times last year's volume in H1, still behind ACC's schedule (CEO); chemicals sales around EUR 45 million in H1, down between 15% and 20% (CFO); solar shows no sign of recovery. SMRs (CEO): Mersen says it is the only integrated isostatic graphite producer in the US, supplies nuclear-grade graphite for Terra Innovatum's first-of-a-kind prototype, has received prototype orders from TerraPower and also works with X-energy; sales will be very low, mostly in 2027, with the ramp expected between 2028 and 2030 as reactors are qualified. CEO: a Defense Logistics Agency contract with an envelope close to $10 million is being delivered.
quarterly_data.figure: EV sales ~EUR 15 million in H1; chemicals ~EUR 45 million (-15% to -20%); DLA contract close to $10 million
